lesson_intro.heading: Cloud Engineer · PM-4.2
lesson_intro.board_text:
Lifecycle Rules and Cost Control
Finova · finova-dev · ap-south-1

Why before how:
Logs and exports grow forever — silence is an expensive bill.

Mental model:
Lifecycle moves or expires objects by age/prefix.

You will: watch → learn → practice one navigation.
lesson_intro.ren_voice: I am Ren. Logs and exports grow forever — silence is an expensive bill. Mental model: Lifecycle moves or expires objects by age/prefix. I demonstrate, then you practice. Least privilege and Region discipline stay non-negotiable.

whiteboard_intro.board_text:
Lifecycle Rules and Cost Control
• Lifecycle moves or expires objects by age/prefix.
• Mistake: Keep everything in Standard 'just in case'.
• Habit: Every log bucket needs a lifecycle on day one.
whiteboard_intro.ren_voice: Board picture: Lifecycle moves or expires objects by age/prefix.. Juniors usually: Keep everything in Standard 'just in case'.. Your habit: Every log bucket needs a lifecycle on day one..

segments.title: Open S3
segments.setup_voice: Watch — we open S3 the way a real ticket starts.

steps.voice: Navigate to S3. Confirm Region ap-south-1 before you trust the empty list.
Buckets without lifecycle are future cost incidents.

segments.lesson_voice: Cost is an engineering requirement — not only FinOps later.

check.voice: What does an S3 lifecycle rule do?
check.response_if_correct: Transition or expire objects automatically by rule.
check.response_if_incorrect: Auto move/delete old objects to control cost.

steps.voice: Finova access logs in Standard for 18 months — six-figure surprise.
